status: Engagement consoles from the SAM Simulator manual. Power-up, deploy and stow are SAM3D's design built on public facts (SAM Simulator's Osa starts deployed and powered); see docs/re/osa.md.
notes: Positions, labels and procedure order come from the manual and the game's control sprites; start positions were measured in the running game (samsim_game, docs/research/OSA_CONSOLE_MAP_2026-10.md §12). Controls whose function isn't known are present but inert (no subsystem uses them). Timings are only included where a source gives them.

sources.notes: Crew, power sources, march/combat positions of the АПУ, readiness norms. Medium confidence.

sources.title: SAM3D design decision
sources.notes: Used where no source gives the detail. Always with confidence 'estimate' and a note saying what it is based on.

stations.label: Commander
stations.notes: Officer; front cab beside the driver. Receives designations from the battery PU-12 by radio and gives the orders. The АПУ controls here are SAM3D placements (their real seat isn't known); power is the driver's (PU-303, rwd_mb3).

stations.label: Deputy commander
stations.notes: Launch console (key, ПУСК ГОТОВ, missile selection), elevation wheel and dial, TV monitor. Control ids keep SAM Simulator's 'fo.' (Firing Officer) prefix.

stations.label: Senior operator
stations.notes: Search radar (SOC) scope, IFF, azimuth wheel: puts the target under the SSC azimuth line.

stations.label: Operator
stations.notes: Range indicator and range wheel; SSC transmitter and capture (ТСЦ). The NVA senior operator also sets the range mark on the search scope; SAM3D has one range wheel, so it is the operator's (sam3d).

stations.label: Driver
stations.notes: Front cab. Works the power supply: the power-supply control panel PU-303 is at his left (rwd_mb3).

launch.notes: Restarts: after a launch ПУСК ГОТОВ goes out and lights again when the next missile can be launched (p30). The manual gives no time; SAM3D repeats missile preparation (the 15 s spin-up), confidence estimate.

sensors.notes: Maps the SOC, SSC and TOV onto this console for the gameplay engagement model (simcore/engagement.hpp). Gameplay thresholds live in data/gameplay/osa_ak.json.

search.notes: Scales p15 item 5; СДЦ works to 35 km, p15 item 12.

track.notes: SSC displayed range 28 km (p16); TOV lenses 5° wide / 1.5° narrow (p17); ±330° azimuth (p14, p16).

inputs.description: The vehicle is stationary (a short halt or a firing position)
inputs.source: wrk; mis (tracking and launch only from a short halt or stationary)

inputs.description: Target will reach the firing zone within 15 s (ВНИМАНИЕ lamp)
Target is within the firing zone (ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ lamp)
Target too low for the SSC radar to track in angle (НЛЦ lamp)
SSC is on the target azimuth and the target is inside the range gate, so it captures automatically

controls.label: ГТА (gas-turbine power unit)
controls.source: wrk (9И120 unit powers the vehicle on the move and at a halt); station: rwd_mb3 (power-supply control panel PU-303 at the driver's left); control: sam3d
controls.notes: The unit is real, and the power system's control panel PU-303 is the driver's (medium). Its labels can't be read in any picture found, so one on/off switch stands in for the start sequence.

controls.label: power take-off generator
controls.source: wrk (engine-driven generator, at a halt only); control: sam3d
controls.notes: Real control and label not known.

controls.label: АПУ travel lock
controls.source: wrk (АПУ locked in travel position on the march; crew unlocks it at a halt); control: sam3d
controls.notes: The lock is real; whether it is one switch, and where, isn't known.

controls.label: search antenna (transport stowage)
controls.source: gs (folds back 90° for air transport and fast road travel), wrk (АПУ stowed for Il-76 transport); control: sam3d
controls.notes: Starts raised: the normal march is with the antenna up (search on the move is possible). Folding is for transport only.

controls.label: ПОИСК
controls.notes: SOC search antenna rotation.

controls.label: ВЫСОКОЕ
controls.notes: SOC transmitter.

controls.label: ДАЛЬНОСТЬ
controls.source: samsim_osa p15 (item 5); position order from sprites osa017–019; start: samsim_game
controls.notes: Starts at 0–35 km, the working scale (ePap, samsim_thread 19 May 2013). No red dot on this switch.

controls.label: ЛУЧ
controls.notes: Five buttons with an illuminated indicator in the game; modelled as one selector since only one can be active. Starts on beam I (I ЛУЧ lit, samsim_game). In I–III the lit lamp steps from beam to beam as the antenna scans (not modelled).

controls.label: СДЦ / ШТ. (SOC)
controls.notes: Moving target indicator, works to 35 km. On OP63-6M2 below the scope. Starts at ШТ. (normal video).

controls.label: ПЕРЕДАТЧИК
controls.notes: SSC tracking-radar transmitter.

controls.label: АЗИМУТ
controls.notes: Slow rotation by dragging; ВЛЕВО/ВПРАВО give fast rotation (not modelled separately).

controls.label: range wheel
controls.source: samsim_osa p16 (item 9; range indicator shows 28 km)
controls.notes: Moves the range gate. Range limits taken from the indicator's displayed range.

controls.label: СДЦ / ШТ. (SSC)
controls.notes: On OS61-5M. Starts at ШТ.

controls.label: ПОЛУАВТОМАТ
controls.notes: Range-only tracking by the SSC.

controls.label: РАБОТА / КОНТРОЛЬ / КАЛИБР.
controls.source: samsim_osa p24 photo (labels); samsim_game (starts away from РАБОТА; red dot at РАБОТА)
controls.notes: Range indicator's check and calibration selector. The game has two sprites and starts with the pointer near КОНТРОЛЬ; one left click gives РАБОТА. Inert: no visible effect in the game, real function not described.

controls.label: ЦЕЛЬ
controls.source: samsim_sprites osa014–016; samsim_osa p16, p24 photos; start: samsim_game
controls.notes: On the range indicator, right of the ГОРИЗ. СМЕЩ. trim knob. Scale marks unreadable. Inert: no effect at idle in the game; what it does with a target is a question for the creator.

controls.label: УГОЛ МЕСТА
controls.notes: In the running game the wheel turned whatever was done to its lock (samsim_game); SAM3D keeps the lock, as the manual describes it (p23).

controls.label: РУ
controls.notes: Manual tracking mode. Button vs. switch not stated; clicked in the manual.

controls.label: ЦУ
controls.source: samsim_osa p23 (item 3; the photo's marker is on the ЦУ button); samsim_game
controls.notes: Engages automatic target acquisition, the manual's 'ЦУ АЗ': in the game it lights both the ЦУ and АЗ lamps and puts out РУ. Accepted with nothing else set up (no refusal). Id kept from the old label.

controls.label: АЗ
controls.source: samsim_osa p17, p23 photos (button between ЦУ and РУ); samsim_game
controls.notes: Inert. In the game pressing it does nothing, from РУ or from ЦУ; its lamp lights with ЦУ. Real function unknown (question for the creator).

controls.label: ПА
controls.notes: Angle tracking with the TOV camera.

controls.label: РАБ.РЕЖ.
controls.notes: TOV camera on/off.

controls.label: РОД РАБОТЫ
controls.source: samsim_osa p29 (БР = live firing, leftmost); ТР: samsim_thread (ePap, 6 Jul 2013); two positions from sprites osa022–023; start: samsim_game
controls.notes: Starts at ТР (training, with the 9Ф632 trainer connected); one click to БР lights the БР lamp (samsim_game). Red dot at БР. The real dial has two more marks, read as РР and ФК at low resolution; the game has two positions. ePap: in ТР the real vehicle can't lock and fire; SAM3D, like the game, only blocks the launch.

controls.label: БОРТ СПК
controls.notes: Starts missile, SPK and SVR preparation by hand.

controls.label: ПОМЕХА
controls.notes: ПОМЕХА (up) = jamming target: the radio proximity fuse arms right after launch (range unknown). Starts at ОТКЛ.

controls.label: ЗАПРЕТ ПУСКА
controls.notes: Launch authorization key.

controls.label: missile selector
controls.source: samsim_sprites osa024–030; samsim_osa p29 photo (dial marks); flak11 (a rotary switch picks another missile); start: samsim_game
controls.notes: Centre ОТКЛ. = automatic selection. Inert until the missile channels are modelled (roadmap 6.3); title unreadable.

controls.label: КАНАЛЫ
controls.source: samsim_sprites osa031–033; samsim_osa p29 photo; start: samsim_game
controls.notes: Missile channel II, channel I, or both together. Starts at СОВМ., on its red dot. Inert until 6.3; no effect at idle in the game.

controls.label: СМЕНА РКТ
controls.source: samsim_sprites osa050–052; samsim_osa p29 photo; samsim_game (one three-step control that stays at СМЕНА)
controls.notes: A knob under a hinged latch: opening the latch and turning the knob are one stepwise control, as in the game. Probably changes to the next missile (смена ракеты), inferred from the label. Inert until 6.3.

controls.label: …МЦ
controls.source: samsim_osa p29 photo (low resolution, first letter unreadable); sprites osa044–045; start: samsim_game
controls.notes: Toggle at the launch console's top left. Inert; function unknown.

controls.label: guard over АВАРИЙНЫЙ ПУСК
controls.source: samsim_sprites osa042–043; samsim_osa p29 photo; start: samsim_game

controls.label: АВАРИЙНЫЙ ПУСК
controls.notes: Throws a missile off unguided when the launcher has lost power, or to get rid of missiles fast. Inert in SAM3D.

start_time_s.source: wrk (readiness within 4 min including GTA start); split: sam3d
start_time_s.notes: No source gives the GTA start time alone. 60 s keeps the whole march-to-combat sequence well inside 4 minutes.

subsystems.name: Engine power take-off generator on line
subsystems.notes: Drops out as soon as the vehicle moves.

subsystems.name: Search antenna raised (not stowed for transport)

start_time_s.notes: No source gives the folding time.

stop_time_s.notes: No source gives the folding time.

subsystems.notes: Starts raised, like its switch: the normal march is with the antenna up; folding is for transport. Raising and folding are driven, so they surely need power, but the equipment model can't make power a condition of moving only (as an enable, a power cut would fold a raised antenna; as a prerequisite, it would fault it), so they don't need it here. SAM3D decision.

subsystems.name: АПУ unlocked (can slew in azimuth)
subsystems.source: wrk (unlocked at a halt; 13 s norm includes unlocking and slewing, so unlocking itself is quick)
subsystems.notes: Faulting when the vehicle moves with the АПУ unlocked is a SAM3D rule (sam3d, estimate): the sources only say it is locked for the march.

subsystems.name: SOC search antenna rotating
subsystems.source: samsim_osa p15; power and raised antenna: wrk, gs

subsystems.name: Automatic target acquisition mode (ЦУ АЗ)
subsystems.notes: In the game ЦУ lights ЦУ and АЗ; РУ puts both out and lights РУ again (manual mode).

subsystems.name: Automatic tracking (ТСЦ angle, АВТОМАТ range lamps)
TOV angle tracking (ПА)
subsystems.notes: Release by РУ is a guess to check in the game.

subsystems.name: SSC range-only tracking (ПОЛУАВТОМАТ)
subsystems.notes: Release when the SSC transmitter goes off is a guess to check in the game.

subsystems.name: Missile, SPK and SVR preparation (ЗАХВАТ, ВКЛ ВЫС, then ПУСК ГОТОВ)

start_time_s.source: samsim_osa p27 (gyroscope spin-up before launch: 15 s), p29

subsystems.source: samsim_osa p29 (starts automatically with ВНИМАНИЕ), p34 (started by hand with БОРТ СПК)
subsystems.notes: Ready = ПУСК ГОТОВ lit. Whether preparation continues if ВНИМАНИЕ goes out again is not described.

subsystems.name: Launch circuit armed (live-fire mode, key turned, missile ready)
subsystems.notes: SAM3D's name for the condition under which ПУСК launches; not a lamp in the manual.

procedures.name: Start the gas-turbine power unit
procedures.source: wrk (GTA powers the vehicle on the move and at a halt; readiness within 4 min including its start); steps: sam3d
procedures.notes: Driver (power-supply control panel PU-303, rwd_mb3). Can be done on the move. The real start sequence isn't public; one switch stands in for it.

steps.description: Start the ГТА

procedures.name: Come into action at a halt
procedures.source: wrk (pull off the road, unlock the АПУ; engine generator works at a halt only); steps: sam3d
procedures.notes: Commander. Tracking and launch are only possible from a halt (wrk, mis). The 13 s norm for unlocking, slewing and taking up manual tracking (wrk) is the target for a trained crew. The driver puts the second power source on line at the same time (pto_on_line).

steps.description: Vehicle stopped off the road: unlock the АПУ

procedures.name: Power take-off generator on line
procedures.source: wrk (two independent power sources; the engine generator works at a halt only); steps: sam3d
procedures.notes: Driver.

steps.description: Vehicle stopped: put the engine power take-off generator on line as a second power source

procedures.name: Search with the SOC on the march
procedures.source: wrk (search possible on the move; a trained crew starts in beam II with СДЦ on); control names: samsim_osa p15
procedures.notes: Senior operator.

steps.description: ПОИСК ВКЛ, SOC antenna rotation on
II ЛУЧ, search in the middle beam
СДЦ on, so ground clutter drops out
Remove the guard over ВЫСОКОЕ
ВЫСОКОЕ ВКЛ, SOC transmitter on

procedures.name: Autonomous target acquisition with the SOC radar
procedures.notes: Senior operator: find the target and put the SSC azimuth line on it. Several steps wait for target geometry (50, 35 km) that the sim provides later; those waits are in the descriptions. The same order goes with ready_capture (deputy commander) and capture_with_ssc (operator).

steps.description: When the target nears 50 km on the plotting board: ПОИСК ВКЛ, SOC antenna rotation on
Remove the guard over ВЫСОКОЕ
ВЫСОКОЕ ВКЛ, SOC transmitter on
I–III ЛУЧ, scan all three height beams
ДАЛЬНОСТЬ 10–45 km
When the echo shows, select the beam it appeared in (beam I in the manual's example)
Unlock the azimuth wheel
ПОДСВЕТКА, light the azimuth indicator
At about 35 km: ДАЛЬНОСТЬ 0–35 km. Then turn the azimuth wheel until the SSC line crosses the target mark

procedures.name: Ready the SSC for automatic capture
procedures.notes: Deputy commander, during acquire_with_soc.

steps.description: Unlock the elevation wheel
ПОДСВЕТКА, light the elevation indicator
ЦУ АЗ, automatic target acquisition

procedures.name: Capture the target with the SSC
procedures.source: samsim_osa p22–24; seats: flak11 (9A33-3: the operator captures with ТСЦ)
procedures.notes: Operator, during acquire_with_soc. Before the transmitter goes on, move the range gate to about 27.5 km with the range wheel.

steps.description: Remove the guard over ПЕРЕДАТЧИК
ЦУ АЗ selected, target at about 30 km: ПЕРЕДАТЧИК ВКЛ, SSC transmitter on. The SSC then captures the target by itself (ТСЦ and АВТОМАТ light)

procedures.name: Tracking a target at ultra-low altitude
procedures.notes: Deputy commander. The operator tracks range at the same time (track_range_semi_auto). The azimuth wheel is the senior operator's.

steps.description: НЛЦ is lit: РАБ.РЕЖ. ВКЛ, TOV camera on
РУ, manual tracking mode. Then bring the target under the TV crosshair with the azimuth and elevation wheels
ПА, angle tracking with the TOV camera

procedures.name: Range-only tracking with the SSC
procedures.notes: Operator, while the deputy commander tracks angles with the TV (track_low_target).

steps.description: Bring the echo into the range gate with the range wheel, then ПОЛУАВТОМАТ, range-only tracking

procedures.name: Preparation for firing
procedures.notes: Deputy commander. Also: check the missiles available on each launcher and watch the target distance on the ДЦ voltmeter (10 V = 10 km).

steps.description: РОД РАБОТЫ to БР, live firing
Insert the launch authorization key (ЗАПРЕТ ПУСКА)

procedures.name: Launch
procedures.notes: Deputy commander. After СХОД, when ПУСК ГОТОВ lights again, a second missile can be launched with ПУСК.

steps.description: ПУСК ГОТОВ and ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ lit: turn the launch key
ПУСК

procedures.name: Emissions control: azimuth onto the plotting-board track
procedures.notes: Senior operator, with emcon_tv_engagement (deputy commander).

steps.description: ПОДСВЕТКА, light the azimuth indicator
Unlock the azimuth wheel, then turn towards the target's azimuth from the plotting board

procedures.name: Engagement with emissions control (TV only, radars silent)
procedures.notes: Deputy commander; the senior operator turns the azimuth (emcon_tv_azimuth). Range is judged from the target's size in the narrow-lens crosshair, so ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ is not awaited.

steps.description: When the target nears 50 km on the plotting board: РАБ.РЕЖ. ВКЛ, TOV camera on
ПОДСВЕТКА, light the elevation indicator
Unlock the elevation wheel (p23), then scan slowly upwards until the target shows on the TV and bring it into the crosshair
ПА, angle tracking with the TOV camera
РОД РАБОТЫ to БР, live firing
Remove the guard over БОРТ СПК
БОРТ СПК ВКЛ, start missile, SPK and SVR preparation by hand
ПОМЕХА up, so the fuse arms right after launch
Insert the launch authorization key
УГОЛ ЗРЕНИЯ УЗКИЙ, narrow lens
When the target fills the crosshair (roughly within range): turn the launch key
ПУСК

procedures.name: Stow the SSC for the march
procedures.notes: Operator, with stow_launch_console (deputy commander), pto_off_line (driver) and stow_for_march (commander).

steps.description: ПЕРЕДАТЧИК ОТКЛ, SSC transmitter off
Close the guard over ПЕРЕДАТЧИК

procedures.name: Stow the launch console and TV for the march
procedures.notes: Deputy commander. Take out the launch key before this if it is in (turn it back, then remove it).

steps.description: РАБ.РЕЖ. ВЫКЛ, TOV camera off
БОРТ СПК off
Close the guard over БОРТ СПК

procedures.name: Power take-off generator off line
procedures.source: wrk (engine generator at a halt only); steps: sam3d
procedures.notes: Driver, before moving off.

steps.description: Take the power take-off generator off line

procedures.name: Stow for the march
procedures.source: wrk (on the march the АПУ is locked in the travel position, SSC antenna facing rear); steps: sam3d
procedures.notes: Commander. The SOC can keep searching on the march, so it is left alone. The operator switches the SSC off first (stow_ssc) and the senior operator turns the SSC antenna to the rear (azimuth wheel to 180°).

steps.description: SSC off and antenna facing rear: lock the АПУ for travel

procedures.name: Stop the SOC for transport
procedures.source: gs (search radar folds back for air transport); steps: sam3d
procedures.notes: Senior operator, before stow_for_transport (commander).

steps.description: ВЫСОКОЕ ВЫКЛ, SOC transmitter off
Close the guard over ВЫСОКОЕ
ПОИСК ВЫКЛ, stop the SOC antenna

procedures.name: Stow for air or rail transport
procedures.source: gs (search radar folds back 90° for air transport and fast road travel), wrk (АПУ stowed for Il-76 transport); steps: sam3d
procedures.notes: Commander. Stow for the march first; the senior operator stops the SOC (stop_search), and the driver shuts down the ГТА once the antenna is folded (power_down).

steps.description: SOC stopped: fold the search antenna down for transport

procedures.name: Shut down the gas-turbine power unit
procedures.notes: Driver, with stow_for_transport (commander): the antenna folds under power first.

steps.description: Shut down the ГТА once the antenna is folded
